summary: Comprehensive backend testing for Groveno Fresh Node.js API. Executed 65 test cases across all channels: customer/admin/CL auth, catalog (products/categories/pickup-points), 3 order channels (home-delivery, express-pickup, cl-order/cl-bulk), live pickup tracking, coins, wallet, CL dashboard, admin dashboard/management, admin CRUD (products/categories/pickup-points), mock payment (create+verify), QR tracking, and rating/skip-rating. All 65 tests PASSED. Business rules validated: order number pattern /^GRV-\d{4}-\d{5}$/, free delivery >=₹199 (else ₹30), express_30min +₹15, pickup 5% discount + ₹30 confirmation fee, CL commission 5%, 4-digit pickup OTP, cross-role auth guards (customer token rejected on CL and admin routes).

minor.issue: MongoDB _id fields are exposed in responses. Not blocking but recommend using virtual `id` and toJSON transform to hide `_id`/`__v` for cleaner API output.

Mongoose validation/duplicate-key errors return HTTP 500 with a full stack trace in the response body. Should be caught in errorHandler middleware, returning 400 for validation errors and stripping stack trace outside development.

Field naming inconsistency: create-order returns 'razorpayOrderId' but verify expects 'paymentId' (not 'razorpayPaymentId') and 'signature' (not 'razorpaySignature'). Aligning to Razorpay's official field names (razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature) would ease integration.
Requires exactly 'societyName' — payload previously used 'society'. Consider accepting both aliases or documenting clearly.

action_items: Optional: exclude Mongo _id/__v from JSON responses via toJSON transform.
Optional: return 400 instead of 500 for Mongoose ValidationError and duplicate-key (E11000) errors, and hide stack trace outside dev.
Optional: standardize Razorpay verify field names to razorpay_order_id / razorpay_payment_id / razorpay_signature to match Razorpay SDK convention.
critical_code_review_comments: server.js: CORS_ORIGINS split will crash if env var is unset (no fallback). Consider `(process.env.CORS_ORIGINS || '*').split(',')`.
auth.controller.js: OTP store is in-memory Map — will not scale across replicas but acceptable for dev/mock mode.
product.controller.js CRUD: no try/wrap for ValidationError → returns 500. Add error normalization in errorHandler middleware.
order.controller.js: business rules are hard-coded constants at file top — consider moving to a config module for easier tuning.

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed data (10 products, 5 categories, 2 pickup points, 1 CL, 1 admin). Tests created several TEST_-prefixed users/orders/categories/products/pickup-points; test flow tolerates residual data through unique timestamp suffixes on re-runs.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs, all tests pass. Only optional hardening recommendations noted under minor issues.
